spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (कोचति)
1 To sound high, to utter a loud, shrill cry, as a bird.
2 To go.
3 To polish.
4 To touch.
5 To furrow or mark with lines.
6 To be crooked.
7 To write.
8 To oppose.
9 To contend.
10 To be restricted or confined, to contract.
r. 6th cl. (शि) शिकुच. (कुचति) or with सं prefixed, (संकोचति or संकुचति)
1 To straiten, to narrow or contract.
2 To be straitened, to shrink, to contract.
With उत्
to bribe;
with वि and आ,
to expand.

m. (-चः)
A breast, a pap.
E.
कुच to bind or confine, क aff.

m. (-चः)
A breast, a female breast, especially that of a young or unmarried woman: see कुच.
f. (-ची)
A painting brush or pencil.
E.
कु to sound, चट Uṇādi affix, and the vowel made long.

m. (-म्भः)
The female breast.
E.
कुच, and कुम्भ vase.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides): see मूर्व्वा.

n. (-टं)
The female breast.
E.
कुच, and तट bank.

n. (-ग्रं)
A nipple.
E.
कुचतट, and अग्र tip.

n. (-नं)
Red sanders, (Pterocarpus santolinus.)
2 Sappan or log wood: see पत्राङ्ग.
3

Saffron.
4

A leguminous plant, (Adenanthera pavonina.)
E.
कु bad, inferior, and चन्दन Sandal.

m. (-लः)
The pomegranate.
E.
कुच, and फल fruit of the shape of the breast.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
1 Censorious, detracting.
2 Following evil practices, low, vile, wicked.
E.
कु vile, and चर who goes.

f. (-र्य्या)
Impropriety, wickedness.
E.
कु bad, चर्य्या practice.

n. (-ग्रं)
A nipple.
E.
कुच a breast, and अग्र point, end.

f. (-री)
Wood sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha): see चाङ्गेरी.

mf. (-कः-का)
A kind of fish, in shape like an eel, commonly Kunchiya, (Unibranchapertura Cuchiya, Ham.)

f. (-का)
A small brush or hair pencil.
E.
कुच to be curved, and क्वुन् affix, with the fem. affix टाप्.

mf. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Closed, contracted.
2 Measured.
E.
कुच to contract, कितच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Ill clothed, dressed in dirty or tattered garments.
f. (-लः-ली)
A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra): see विद्धकर्णी.
E.
कु bad, and चेला a garment.

n. (-च्छं)
The white water lily.
